institution.name: Agency for Science, Technology and Research (A*STAR) Graduate Academy

qualifications: Singapore citizens or permanent residents: at least a Second-Class (Upper) Honours degree or equivalent in a relevant discipline (obtained or on track)
Non-SPR foreigners: completed or on track to obtain at least a Second-Class (Upper) Honours degree at a Singapore autonomous university
Must meet the criteria for, and gain admission to, a PhD programme at an autonomous university in Singapore
Non-SPR foreigners serve a three-year bond in a Singapore-based company; no bond for citizens and permanent residents
description_short: A*STAR scholarship funding PhD studies of up to four years at a Singapore autonomous university. The first application cycle opens 1 November and closes 1 February; interviews follow from mid-February to March, with outcomes from mid-April.

deadline.evidence_quote: 1 Nov to 1 Feb & 5 Jun to 1 Aug
